evals.prompt: Create a meme coin called BIZRA on Ethereum with 1 billion total supply, 3% buy tax and 5% sell tax going to a marketing wallet. Make it so the owner can reduce but never increase the tax. Include the full Hardhat project with deploy script and tests.
evals.expected_output: Complete Hardhat project with a Solidity ERC-20 contract featuring tax mechanism with only-decrease modifier, deployment script for Sepolia, test file, hardhat.config.js, .env.example, and README
expectations: A Solidity contract file exists with pragma solidity ^0.8
The contract implements buy and sell tax logic with basis points
Tax can only be decreased, never increased (monotonic decrease guard)
A Hardhat deployment script exists
A test file exists with at least 3 test cases
A hardhat.config.js or hardhat.config.ts exists with network configs
A .env.example file exists with placeholder for private key
Total supply is 1 billion tokens
A security checklist or security notes are included

evals.prompt: I want to launch an NFT collection on Solana — 10,000 PFPs called 'Desert Guardians' with 7.5% royalties. Set up everything I need including the metadata format and a candy machine config.
evals.expected_output: Solana NFT project with Metaplex integration, collection setup, metadata JSON template, candy machine configuration, mint script, and deployment instructions
expectations: Metaplex or equivalent NFT framework is used
Collection size is configured for 10,000 items
Royalty is set to 7.5% (750 basis points)
A metadata JSON template following Metaplex standard is included
Deployment instructions for Solana devnet are provided
The collection name 'Desert Guardians' is used throughout
A README or guide explains the full setup and deployment process

evals.prompt: Build me a governance token on TON called SHURA with 100M supply. I need a Jetton contract with the ability to mint up to max supply, plus a simple staking mechanism where holders can lock tokens for 30 days to earn rewards. Include tests.
evals.expected_output: TON Blueprint project with Tact Jetton contract, staking contract, deployment scripts, test files, and tokenomics documentation
expectations: A Tact or FunC Jetton contract exists following TEP-74
Max supply is set to 100 million tokens
The token is named SHURA
A staking contract or mechanism is included with 30-day lock
Deployment script for TON testnet exists
Test file exists with at least 2 test cases
A README or guide explains how to build and deploy
